maria (DevEx): Heads-up — ran into a confusing failure in the next-rag-sample wizard. When the app hits an auth error the SDK's retry/backoff path sometimes causes a full stream hang (client waits forever). Telemetry tags it as 'auth' but logs show repeated backoff cycles. Repro in ./examples/next-rag-sample + small patch below.

sam (SDK): Can you paste the minimal logs + the code path you use for the request?

maria (DevEx): Logs: ```
[2024-11-02T15:23:01Z] fetch /v1/generate 401 {"message":"invalid api key"}
[2024-11-02T15:23:01Z] retry handler invoked (auth)
[2024-11-02T15:23:05Z] fetch /v1/generate 429 {"message":"rate limited"}
[2024-11-02T15:23:05Z] backoff wait 10s
[2024-11-02T15:23:15Z] fetch /v1/generate 429
...
```
Code snippet from the sample (edge route): ```js
// pages/api/generate.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retry: { maxRetries: 3 } });
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const stream = await client.generateStream({ model: 'redwood/gpt-stream' });
  stream.on('data', chunk => res.write(chunk));
}
```
The stream never emits after the first auth->429 sequence. Telemetry shows event=\"auth_failure\" but the real problem is retry/backoff scheduling cancelling the stream emitter.

joni (Eng): Huh — sounds like SDK retries are swallowing the stream subscription. If initial response is 401 then the token refresh path probably triggers, and the retry wrapper replays the request but doesn't reattach the stream event handlers.

sam (SDK): That matches a race we missed in the streaming client. Our generic retry wrapper currently assumes requests are idempotent sync responses, not long-lived streaming sockets. We should special-case streaming endpoints to do auth-only immediate error bubbling (no retry), or ensure the wrapper reattaches the stream listeners after a replay.

maria (DevEx): Quick workaround I tested: set retry.maxRetries=0 in the sample app -> stream recovers immediately (no hang). Not ideal for users that expect built-in retries. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Buildkite: #4532 succeeded for branch next-rag-sample-patch (artifact: logs.tar.gz) :white_check_mark:

kate (Docs): We should add a note to the RAG starter README mentioning streaming endpoints and the current SDK behavior, plus the workaround. Also add a short example showing how to disable retries for streaming calls. I'll draft a tiny snippet.

sam (SDK): Plan: 1) ship a small patch to the retry wrapper to detect stream responses and avoid replaying them (or replay that preserves handlers). 2) release SDK v0.11.3-canary and bump the sample's package.json in a PR. 3) add an e2e test in the sample harness that simulates 401->429 sequence. I'll open a PR today.

joni (Eng): I can add the e2e test to ./examples/next-rag-sample/tests/stream-retry.spec.ts — will mock the server to return 401 then 429 then successful stream.

maria (DevEx): Thanks — can we get a hosted canary for the sample app so product folks can smoke-test?

sam (SDK): Yes — I'll coordinate with infra to canary the SDK on hosted. If no regressions, we'll promote in 48h. Leaving a note to add a telemetry flag so future incidents show 'stream-retry' vs generic 'auth'.

kate (Docs): Drafted note for README and quick fix snippet: ```md
Note: Streaming endpoints currently bypass replaying retries. If you see a hang after an auth error, set `retry.maxRetries: 0` for the streaming client or upgrade to SDK v0.11.3+.
```

maria (DevEx): Confirmed workaround in prod-staging -> sample app resumes streaming. Will add a short blurb to the onboarding checklist so new users don't get blocked. :rocket:

sam (SDK): Thanks all — PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1793 (patch + canary). Will post canary link here once CI passes.

joni (Eng): Adding the e2e now.

maria (DevEx): Great, closing the loop — follow-up if anything odd pops up.
